GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Waves 3.4 Magnetism and Electromagnetic Induction Page 15 of 58 1 STRAND 1.0: LI and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Waves ● Terms used in waves ● The wave equation ● Properties of waves ● Applicat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and electromagnetic induction ● Magnetisation and demagnetisation ● Ma and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
